# KALOS Personal Training Studio

> KALOS is a private, appointment-only personal training studio in Richmond, BC (Metro Vancouver), Canada, built for physique transformation — muscle gain, fat loss, and strength. Coaching is strictly one-on-one: every coach runs the same proven method, every session is tracked, and clients are matched to the coach who fits their goal. The studio opens in fall 2026.

Key facts:

- Location: 12060 Vulcan Way, Richmond, British Columbia V6V 1J8, Canada (Bridgeport area). Opening fall 2026; the studio is currently in build-out.
- Format: private one-on-one personal training by appointment only — no open-gym memberships, no group classes.
- Method: goal-first coaching. Every engagement starts with a specific, measurable target with a date on it. Strength is anchored by max-effort benchmark sets; hypertrophy volume is calculated from the client's own numbers; progression is programmed, not improvised.
- Consistency: one standard across the team — every coach runs the same method, so results don't depend on which trainer you get.
- Tracking: every session, lift, and check-in is logged in the KALOS software (web client portal + iOS app), including personal records, body-weight trends, food logging, and progress reviews.
- Getting started: a free 60-minute consultation, booked at https://kalospt.ca/contact/ — goals, training history, and a coach match before any purchase.
- Packages (one-on-one sessions, prices in CAD): Starter — 12 sessions at $130/session ($1,560); Momentum — 24 sessions at $115/session ($2,760); Transformation — 36 sessions at $105/session ($3,780); VIP — 48 sessions at $100/session ($4,800).
- Contact: hello@kalospt.ca · Instagram @kalos.pt
